name: Pine-Richland Youth Wrestling’s 4th Annual 2027 RAM SLAM
weighin: 1/29: 6:00–8:00 PM (All Divisions) | 1/30: 7:00–8:00 AM (All Divisions) | 11:00 AM–12:00 PM (Novice/Girls ONLY)
about:
Pine-Richland Youth Wrestling’s 
4th Annual 2027 RAM SLAM
SATURDAY, January 30th at Pine-Richland High School
702 Warrendale Dr., Gibsonia, PA 15044
Doors open at 7:00 AM – Athletic Entrance

Registration Deadline: 3:00 PM on 1/29/2027 — NO WALK-INS

Start Times: 9:00 AM Open | 1:00 PM Girls & Novice

Awards: 
1st place oversized rings for OPEN, 2nd thru 4th Trophies 
1st place oversized rings for GIRLS, 2nd thru 4th Trophies 
Novice: 1st thru 4th Trophies

Novice Division:
6 & under 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 85 (max)
8 & under 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 90, 100, 120 (max)
10 & under 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 105, 115, 130, 150 (max)
12 & under 70, 85, 100, 115, 130, 150, 175 (max)

Open Division:
8 & under 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 90, 100, 120 (max)
10 & under 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 105, 115, 130, 150 (max)
12 & under 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100, 105, 115, 125, 135, 145, 160, 180 (max)
15 & under 85, 90, 95, 100, 105, 110, 115, 125, 130, 138, 155, 185, 240 (max)
 
Girls’ Division:
There is no experience criteria for the Girls’ Division; however, wrestlers will be matched up by approximate weight and age (possibly experience) after registration is complete using Madison Style weight system.

Registration & Entry Fee: $40 per wrestler; no discount for double bracketing. Double bracketing is permitted for Open and Novice, age-up brackets, and girls wrestling in boys’ divisions. Team pricing is available for 10 or more wrestlers from the same team - contact PRYW at 412-779-0267.

Weigh-Ins: Located at PR High School; see page 2 for instructions. 1/29: 6:00–8:00 PM (All Divisions) or 1/31: 7:00–8:00 AM (All Divisions), 11:00 AM–12:00 PM (Novice/Girls ONLY). Flat weight, no allowance for Open. 1 lb. allowance for Novice. Skin and fingernail checks will be performed. Bring a completed PIAA Skin Form signed by a licensed physician for any questionable skin condition. Weights may be adjusted at the scales.

Eligibility & Clarifications: Registration age as of 12/31/2026. Novice is for wrestlers in their 1st or 2nd year (no experience prior to October 1, 2025). All 6U wrestlers are considered novice regardless of experience. Open is for wrestlers with more than 2 years of experience. There is no experience requirement for the Girls’ Division. Referee and Tournament Director decisions are final.
Rules & Times: Double elimination. Wrestle-back for TRUE SECOND for Open only. Classic overtime rules apply. Weight classes may be combined at the Tournament Director’s discretion. 
1-1-1 for 6U, 8U, 10U, 12U
1.5-1.5-1.5 for 15&U

Additional Information: Spectator admission is $10 per adult; students are FREE. Concessions are available ALL DAY in the foyer. The campus is smoke-free and tobacco-free. Security cameras are in place around campus.Tournament brackets will be run on ArenaFlo and projected on the jumbotron in the main gym.
